_note: Outreach rules per country for a first, unsolicited B2B touch. Configuration for counsel to review, not legal advice.

Germany.basis: UWG §7(2): email needs prior express consent even B2B; a sales call needs at least presumed consent

Austria.basis: TKG 2021 §174: unsolicited email and calls need prior consent

Switzerland.basis: UWG Art. 3(1)(o): mass advertising email needs prior consent

Poland.basis: Telecommunications law: prior consent for direct marketing by email and phone

Czechia.basis: Act 480/2004: commercial email needs prior consent

United Kingdom.basis: PECR: corporate subscribers may be emailed with an opt-out

United States.basis: CAN-SPAM: opt-out, postal address, honest subject line
